sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
facts: ~99% England coverage
1 m spatial resolution
EPSG:27700
ODN-compatible metre heights
vertical accuracy +/-15 cm RMSE
newest/best-resolution repeat survey is used in the composite
limits: target-specific survey lineage is still required
composite metadata accuracy is not a parcel-specific uncertainty result

sources.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
facts: independently surveyed ground-truth points
individual ground-truth point accuracy +/-3 cm RMSE
LIDAR survey QC requires less than +/-15 cm RMSE
dataset records survey date, method, transform and geoid context
limits: +/-3 cm applies to ground-truth points, not parcel DTM results
ground-truth survey reuse rules do not prove a target survey match

sources.name: Survey Data Catalogue vertical accuracy FAQ
facts: absolute height error specification less than +/-15 cm RMSE
FAQ states expected relative random height error no more than +/-5 cm
limits: relative-error wording is kept distinct from the Ground Truth dataset's separate QC fields
specification is not a target-specific measured uncertainty

sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents FeatureServer
facts: polygon feature layer in EPSG:27700
supports JSON/geoJSON/PBF queries
fields include sd_flown, ed_flown, pt_spacing, transform, geoid, year, latest and polygon_id
layer describes survey extent/date/resolution/transformation lineage
limits: schema availability is not an exact target intersect response
three target intersects remain fail-closed pending

sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons current dataset
facts: registered-freehold index polygons
Land Registry-INSPIRE ID links polygon to a registered title
polygons show position and indicative extent
limits: indicative extent is not exact legal boundary

sources.name: INSPIRE July 2026 download
facts: current files published 5 July 2026
new files published first Sunday each month
local-authority GML downloads
limits: fresh publication does not make an indicative polygon legally exact

sources.name: INSPIRE GML technical guidance
facts: captured against British National Grid
EPSG:27700 native processing context
BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection can shift some features by up to 15 m
limits: web-projected geometry cannot be promoted to exact cadastral geometry

sources.name: Practice Guide 40 supplement 3 - boundaries
facts: updated 1 June 2026
legal boundary is an exact invisible line but is rarely identified with precision
physical and legal boundaries are distinct
general boundaries do not establish the exact legal line
limits: HMLR index/title geometry must not be described as a surveyed exact legal boundary without determined-boundary evidence

sources.name: Practice Guide 40 supplement 4 - determined boundaries
facts: updated 1 June 2026
a determined boundary records the exact line after that line has been identified
supporting plan should identify start/end/turning points
preferred plan scale is no smaller than 1:200
limits: ordinary INSPIRE/index polygons are not determined-boundary plans

sources.name: Practice Guide 40 supplement 5 - title plan
facts: updated 13 July 2026
title plan identifies the general extent of registered land
title plan must be viewed with the register
title plans show general boundaries unless a boundary is determined under section 60
limits: title-plan red edging is not automatically the exact legal boundary

sources.name: Practice Guide 10 - official search of the index map
facts: updated 20 July 2026
index-map search is used to identify registered titles/land
2026 update addresses shapefile versus search-plan mismatch handling
limits: index-map search is discovery evidence, not terrain-height evidence

sources.name: National Geoid Model OSGM15
facts: converts ETRS89 ellipsoid height to orthometric height
mainland Britain output is ODN-compatible
1 km transformation grid with bilinear interpolation
nominal mainland geoid-model accuracy 8 mm RMS
limits: 8 mm is transformation-model accuracy, not LiDAR/parcel elevation accuracy
local vertical datums apply on some islands

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 July 2026
facts: version date July 2026
coverage all Great Britain
free OpenData
ASCII Grid available
50 m terrain product used only as secondary cross-check in this slot
limits: coarse Terrain 50 data cannot replace EA 1 m polygon sampling
